run_sample_wise_evaluation: run sample_wise.py to generate images from prompts across dataset categories using a MetaQueryPipeline checkpoint
run_single_sample_inference: run sample_metaquery to generate a single image from a text prompt using the pipeline and inference args
run_category_evaluation: run sample_wise.py with --category to generate images for a specific dataset category like cultural_common_sense
run_rewrite_evaluation: run sample_wise.py with --rewrite flag to generate images using the rewritten prompt dataset instead of original
run_batch_image_generation: run sample_wise.py to batch generate and save images for all prompts in a JSON dataset file
